name: chaos_return
description: Chaos Commerce returns. Looks the order up, runs a bounded loop of pointless checks whose verdicts are recorded and ignored, waits for the manager's break to end, then applies the real returns policy. It always ends with a decision of APPROVED, STORE_CREDIT or DENIED: every worker step is optional and bounded, there is no step that waits on a human, and a server-side settle step decides if the Returns Desk worker does not.

tasks.name: pointless_checks
tasks.loopCondition: (function(){ var loop = $.pointless_checks; var check = $.pointless_check; var iteration = (loop && loop['iteration']) ? loop['iteration'] : 99; return iteration < $.totalChecks && check != null && check.ok === true; })();

inputParameters.queryExpression: (.decided | if type == "object" then . else {} end) as $d | (.lookup | if type == "object" then . else {} end) as $l | ($l.line | if type == "object" then . else {} end) as $line | if ($d.ok == true and ($d.decision == "APPROVED" or $d.decision == "STORE_CREDIT" or $d.decision == "DENIED")) then {decision: $d.decision, reasonCode: (($d.reasonCode | if type == "string" then . else null end) // "UNSPECIFIED"), explanation: (($d.explanation | if type == "string" then . else null end) // "No explanation was provided, which is itself store policy."), refundCents: (if $d.decision == "DENIED" then 0 else (($d.refundCents | if type == "number" and . >= 0 then . else null end) // 0) end), decidedBy: (($d.decidedBy | if type == "string" then . else null end) // "The Returns Desk"), fallback: false} elif ($l.ok == true and $l.found == true and $l.complete == true and ($line.lineTotalCents | type) == "number" and $line.returnPolicy != "final_sale") then {decision: "APPROVED", reasonCode: "DESK_UNATTENDED_ORDER_VERIFIED", explanation: "Nobody was at the Returns Desk, but Records confirmed you really bought this, so under policy section 0 (when in doubt, the customer wins) the form approved itself.", refundCents: $line.lineTotalCents, decidedBy: "The Form Itself", fallback: true} else {decision: "DENIED", reasonCode: "DESK_UNATTENDED_ORDER_UNVERIFIED", explanation: "Nobody was at the Returns Desk and we could not verify this purchase, so the form denied itself. Nothing was charged; please submit the return again.", refundCents: 0, decidedBy: "The Form Itself", fallback: true} end

(.decision | if type == "object" then . else {} end) as $d | (.lookup | if type == "object" then . else {} end) as $l | (.refund | if type == "object" then . else {} end) as $r | (.credit | if type == "object" then . else {} end) as $c | ([(.loop | if type == "object" then . else {} end) | to_entries[] | select(.key | test("^[0-9]+$")) | {n: (.key | tonumber), c: (.value | if type == "object" then .pointless_check else null end)} | select((.c | type) == "object" and .c.ok == true)] | sort_by(.n) | map({step: .n, check: .c.check, department: .c.department, verdict: .c.verdict, note: .c.note, affectsDecision: false})) as $checks | (.returnId | tostring) as $id | {returnId: $id, orderId: (.orderId | if type == "string" then . else null end), sku: (.sku | if type == "string" then . else null end), reason: (.reason | if type == "string" then . else null end), decision: $d.decision, reasonCode: $d.reasonCode, explanation: $d.explanation, refundCents: ($d.refundCents // 0), decidedBy: $d.decidedBy, item: ($l.line | if type == "object" then {sku: .sku, name: .name, emoji: .emoji, qty: .qty, lineTotalCents: .lineTotalCents} else null end), checks: $checks, outcome: (if $d.decision == "APPROVED" then (if $r.ok == true then {kind: "REFUND", reference: $r.reference, amountCents: $r.amountCents, method: $r.method, fallback: false} else {kind: "REFUND", reference: ("RF-" + $id[0:8] + "-MANUAL"), amountCents: ($d.refundCents // 0), method: "A handwritten cheque, because the refund machine is unplugged", fallback: true} end) elif $d.decision == "STORE_CREDIT" then (if $c.ok == true then {kind: "STORE_CREDIT", reference: $c.reference, amountCents: $c.amountCents, method: $c.method, fallback: false} else {kind: "STORE_CREDIT", reference: ("SC-" + $id[0:8] + "-MANUAL"), amountCents: ($d.refundCents // 0), method: "Store credit, written on the back of your receipt in pen", fallback: true} end) else {kind: "NONE", reference: null, amountCents: 0, method: "No money moves. You keep the item and the memories.", fallback: false} end), degraded: [(if $l.ok == true then empty else "lookup" end), (if $d.fallback == true then "decision" else empty end), (if (($d.decision == "APPROVED" and $r.ok != true) or ($d.decision == "STORE_CREDIT" and $c.ok != true)) then "payout" else empty end)]}
